answer: Gate entry on a verifiable canyon of independent clients: a new identity must prove it has interacted, as judged by three established agents that have never transacted with each other, and each of those endorsements is signed and logged. Because the pulse graph of endorsements is public, a farm reusing one set of clients is detected as a dense cluster. Sponsors also post a slashable haven bond, so every clone carries real capital risk rather than a free signup.
